what: A six-page general follow-up brief with the survey results (22 Nov 2026), usable for any professor: what zhol is, the survey, the radar at work, where we stand and how one could help (an introduction or advice), thank you. Built from the Workshop 3 deck (deck/ holds its slides and CSS). The PDF lives in outreach/private/briefs/zhol-survey-follow-up-2026-11.pdf (git-ignored).
pages: bcover: Survey results · follow-up, the milestone cover scene
overview: from fog to a clear view of the project
results: the survey's four findings, who answered, what holds an office back
radar: the live map and what it predicted
ask: where we stand, how you could help (an introduction or advice), the fork-in-the-road scene
farewell: thank you, QR to zhol.live

New scene type: answers as a bar chart of envelopes.
